topics.label: Lecture opening and introduction to complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture topic and outlines the general approach to understanding the complement system.

topics.label: Core principles, nomenclature, and central C3 activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational concepts, naming conventions, and pivotal role of C3 in the complement system.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three distinct biochemical pathways that recognize pathogens and converge to activate complement on target surfaces.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the downstream effector processes through which activated complement eradicates pathogens and promotes immune clearance.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory proteins and mechanisms that protect host cells from unintended complement-mediated damage.

topics.label: Clinical pathology of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the distinct clinical consequences and disease phenotypes resulting from deficiencies in individual complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how pathogens subvert complement defenses to survive within the host.

topics.label: Lecture closing and upcoming topics
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the next subject in the series.
